title: How much does it cost to maintain a website in 2026? - GoDaddy Blog

facts.fact: GoDaddy's blog says website maintenance costs can range from around $5 per month for a basic site to several thousand per month for large, high-traffic, or feature-heavy websites.
facts.quote: website maintenance costs can range from around $5 per month for a basic site to several thousand per month for large, high-traffic, or feature-heavy websites.

facts.fact: GoDaddy's 2026 table lists average monthly maintenance cost for a personal website/blog as $5-$75.
GoDaddy's 2026 table lists average annual maintenance cost for a personal website/blog as $60-$900.
GoDaddy's 2026 table lists average monthly maintenance cost for a small to medium business site as $50-$500.
GoDaddy's 2026 table lists average annual maintenance cost for a small to medium business site as $600-$6,000.
GoDaddy's 2026 table lists average monthly maintenance cost for an ecommerce store as $300-$1,000.
GoDaddy's 2026 table lists average annual maintenance cost for an ecommerce store as $3,600-$12,000.
GoDaddy's 2026 table lists average monthly maintenance cost for a large corporate or custom site as $1,000-$5,000+.
GoDaddy's 2026 table lists average annual maintenance cost for a large corporate or custom site as $12,000-$60,000+.
GoDaddy's 2026 table lists average monthly maintenance cost for an enterprise website as $2,000-$25,000+.
GoDaddy's 2026 table lists average annual maintenance cost for an enterprise website as $24,000-$300,000+.
GoDaddy states that most blog websites cost between $5 and $75 per month to maintain, depending on traffic and features.
facts.quote: Most blog websites cost between $5 and $75 per month to maintain, depending on traffic and features.

facts.fact: GoDaddy states that on average, small to medium business websites cost between $50 and $500 per month to maintain.
facts.quote: On average, SMB websites cost between $50 and $500 per month to maintain.

facts.fact: GoDaddy states that corporate website maintenance costs usually range from $1,000 to $5,000+ (the page text cuts off before stating the time period).
facts.unit: USD (period not shown in extracted text)
facts.quote: Website maintenance costs for corporate websites usually range from $1,000 to $5,000+ per
